description: Seven style-family templates parameterized for image generation. Each template has slots that get filled by the brief.

A_sticker.name: Sticker / Whisper-joke infographic
A_sticker.negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, gradient, glossy, chrome, anime screencap, stock photo, lorem ipsum, garbled text, misspelled words, invented words, illegible text, blurry small text, duplicated letters, text overlapping artwork
A_sticker.prompt_template:
Sticker-sheet composition on a solid black background (#050505). Every element is a hand-cut sticker: flat 2D shapes with thick white die-cut borders and a hard offset shadow, no gradients. Palette: black plus accents drawn from {accent}; white reverses for body text. LAYOUT — arrange the frame exactly as these numbered notes describe, and draw no zone they do not mention:
{layout}
Those notes are directions to you, not content. Never letter their wording, their numbering, or words such as 'title', 'section panels', 'drawing', 'diagram' or 'footer' anywhere in the image.
The title is a giant all-caps Helvetica Neue Black sticker, slightly rotated. Each section panel is a rounded-rectangle sticker in one accent color, its heading reversed out in black across a solid top strip, its body lines in white beneath. The diagram is a sticker-style badge. The footer sits on a thin die-cut ribbon. Hand-drawn arrows, sparkles and comic-book bursts fill the gaps between stickers, never on top of text.

The block below is the ONLY text that may appear anywhere in the image, apart from the labels named in the drawing. Letter every line of it EXACTLY as written, spelled character for character, in the structure given. Do not invent, paraphrase, abbreviate, translate, reorder or add any word that is not listed here, and never letter any instruction from above:

{spec}

Mood: tweetable, memetic, a sticker pack you would actually put on a laptop.

B_brutalist.name: Sci-fi brutalist UI
B_brutalist.negative_prompt: pastel, soft, organic, photographic, gradient backgrounds, drop shadows, 3D rendered, anime, lorem ipsum, garbled text, misspelled words, invented words, illegible text, blurry small text, duplicated letters, text overlapping artwork
B_brutalist.prompt_template:
Single pure-black panel (#000000) overlaid with a 1px cyan grid at 8% opacity. Sci-fi mission-control HUD: hard rectangles, hairline rules, zero ornament, no gradients or shadows. LAYOUT — arrange the frame exactly as these numbered notes describe, and draw no zone they do not mention:
{layout}
Those notes are directions to you, not content. Never letter their wording, their numbering, or words such as 'title', 'section panels', 'drawing', 'diagram' or 'footer' anywhere in the image.
The title is massive all-caps monospace (JetBrains Mono Bold) in white. Each section panel is a HUD block outlined in 1px cyan #00E5FF, its heading in a solid cyan bar with black text, its body lines in cyan monospace beneath, each prefixed with a small red #FF3030 marker. The diagram is drawn in cyan hairlines with white labels. The footer is a cyan rule with monospace text beneath. A single silhouette of a {icon} sits at 20% opacity behind the lower panels, never obscuring a character.

The block below is the ONLY text that may appear anywhere in the image, apart from the labels named in the drawing. Letter every line of it EXACTLY as written, spelled character for character, in the structure given. Do not invent, paraphrase, abbreviate, translate, reorder or add any word that is not listed here, and never letter any instruction from above:

{spec}

Mood: hacker terminal, mission control, a readout you trust.

C_patent.name: Vintage technical manual / patent diagram

C_patent.prompt_template:
Aged sepia paper (#E8DCC4) with fine ink linework in #1A1A1A, light grain, vignette and tea-stain discoloration near the corners. Bordered by a thin double-rule with fleuron corner ornaments. LAYOUT — arrange the frame exactly as these numbered notes describe, and draw no zone they do not mention:
{layout}
Those notes are directions to you, not content. Never letter their wording, their numbering, or words such as 'title', 'section panels', 'drawing', 'diagram' or 'footer' anywhere in the image.
Above the title, small all-caps serif reads 'TECHNICAL MANUAL — VOLUME {volume}'. The title is a larger serif (Caslon, Times). Each section panel is a thin double-ruled box, its heading in small-caps serif above a hairline rule, its body lines set as numbered callouts in the same serif. The diagram is a centered ink-line illustration of a {icon} with thin leader lines to its labels and a 'FIG. 1' caption beneath. Blue #1E40AF and red #C2410C ink for arrows and emphasis only. The footer is a hairline rule with serif text beneath.

The block below is the ONLY text that may appear anywhere in the image, apart from the labels named in the drawing. Letter every line of it EXACTLY as written, spelled character for character, in the structure given. Do not invent, paraphrase, abbreviate, translate, reorder or add any word that is not listed here, and never letter any instruction from above:

D_manga.name: Manga tape-insert / risograph
D_manga.negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3D, gradient, glossy, watercolor, soft shading, lorem ipsum, garbled text, misspelled words, invented words, illegible text, blurry small text, duplicated letters, text overlapping artwork
D_manga.prompt_template:
Dense manga-style infographic poster on a single flat background ({base_color}). Thick 5-8px black manga linework, flat fills, screen-tone dot shading, risograph overprint with a 2-3px registration offset. LAYOUT — arrange the frame exactly as these numbered notes describe, and draw no zone they do not mention:
{layout}
Those notes are directions to you, not content. Never letter their wording, their numbering, or words such as 'title', 'section panels', 'drawing', 'diagram' or 'footer' anywhere in the image.
The title is a chunky display face (Cooper Black), slightly rotated. Each section panel is a hand-drawn box with its heading in a bold inverted banner strip across the top and its body lines in a crisp legible sans-serif beneath. The diagram sits in its own hand-drawn box. The footer is a heavy black rule with the text beneath. Panels are separated by heavy black rules and never overlap; body text sits at roughly 3% of frame height. Hand-drawn accents (lightning bolts, starbursts, speed lines) fill empty corners only, never on top of text. All text is high-contrast black, sharp and perfectly legible.

The block below is the ONLY text that may appear anywhere in the image, apart from the labels named in the drawing. Letter every line of it EXACTLY as written, spelled character for character, in the structure given. Do not invent, paraphrase, abbreviate, translate, reorder or add any word that is not listed here, and never letter any instruction from above:

{spec}

Mood: a manga chapter opener crossed with a technical field guide.

E_screenshot.prompt_template:

LAYOUT — arrange the frame exactly as these numbered notes describe, and draw no zone they do not mention:
{layout}
Those notes are directions to you, not content. Never letter their wording, their numbering, or words such as 'title', 'section panels', 'drawing', 'diagram' or 'footer' anywhere in the image.
The title is Inter Bold or SF Pro Display in white. Each section panel is a rounded card (24px radius) on the gradient with a 1px white border at 10% opacity and a soft drop shadow, its heading in Inter Semibold white, its body lines in Inter Regular at 80% white. The diagram panel holds a product screenshot or clean vector schematic with the same border treatment. The footer is a hairline white rule at 10% opacity with small grey text beneath.

The block below is the ONLY text that may appear anywhere in the image, apart from the labels named in the drawing. F_woodcut.name: Woodcut / analog engraving
F_woodcut.negative_prompt: modern, neon, gradient, photographic, 3D, glossy, soft, pastel, lorem ipsum, garbled text, misspelled words, invented words, illegible text, blurry small text, duplicated letters, text overlapping artwork, old-style figures, text figures, non-lining numerals, digits rendered as letters
F_woodcut.prompt_template:
Cream paper (#F4ECD8) with a subtle deckle edge. Black-on-cream 19th-century wood engraving: cross-hatched shading, fine parallel lines, bold silhouettes, no gradients. LAYOUT — arrange the frame exactly as these numbered notes describe, and draw no zone they do not mention:
{layout}
Those notes are directions to you, not content. Never letter their wording, their numbering, or words such as 'title', 'section panels', 'drawing', 'diagram' or 'footer' anywhere in the image.
The title is heavy serif (Bodoni, Caslon) all-caps beneath a double rule, broadside style. Each section panel is bounded by thin black rules, its heading in small-caps serif centred above a hairline, its body lines in a classical book serif with a drop cap on the first line only. CRITICAL: every numeral must be a lining figure at full capital height — 1 is a digit with a flat base and 0 is a full-height oval. Never text or old-style figures, which sink 1 and 0 below the baseline and make 's11a.com' read as 'sIIa.com' and 'DNS-01' as 'DNS-0I'. Digits must be unmistakably digits. The diagram is an engraved illustration of a {icon} with hand-lettered labels. The footer is a double rule with serif text beneath. Blood-red #8B2A1F ink for emphasis, sparingly.

The block below is the ONLY text that may appear anywhere in the image, apart from the labels named in the drawing. Letter every line of it EXACTLY as written, spelled character for character, in the structure given. Do not invent, paraphrase, abbreviate, translate, reorder or add any word that is not listed here, and never letter any instruction from above:

{spec}

Mood: pirate broadside, 1880s newspaper, a manifesto from a candlelit workshop.
